{{recipe}} 

== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (24 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) skin-on wild [[Cookbook:Salmon|salmon]] filets, pin bones removed
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] mesquite wood chips, soaked in water for 30 minutes
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Chili Powder|chili powder]]
* 1 tbsp kosher salt
* 1 tbsp black [[Cookbook:Peppercorn|peppercorns]], cracked
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
* 2 tbsp light [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* Juice of 2 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemons]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 1 cup [[Cookbook:Kansas City Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]]
* 2 tsp [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]

== Equipment ==
* Kettle-style charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]]
* Large chimney starter
* Charcoal briquets
* Kitchen towel, tied into a roll with kitchen twine, then soaked in cooking oil

== Procedure ==
#Combine lemon juice and olive oil in a gallon-size zip-top bag. Add salmon, [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] to coat, and [[Cookbook:Marinating|marinate]] in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
#Wad up a sheet of newspaper and moisten with vegetable oil. Place under chimney full of coals, which you have put in the bottom of the grill, then light. Wait 15 minutes.
#While charcoal heats, combine seasonings and sugar. Rub into salmon filets.
#Dump coals evenly around grill and toss in wood chips. Re-apply grate, then quickly swab grill with the towel. Add salmon filets, skin side down, to the hottest part of the grill and cook 2–3 minutes per side for medium rare, rotating 90 degrees halfway through cooking to make grill marks.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] meat side with sauce and cook until charred and crispy on the meat side, about 30 seconds. Serve immediately.

steps.text: Combine lemon juice and olive oil in a gallon-size zip-top bag. Add salmon, toss to coat, and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour.
Wad up a sheet of newspaper and moisten with vegetable oil. Place under chimney full of coals, which you have put in the bottom of the grill, then light. Wait 15 minutes.
While charcoal heats, combine seasonings and sugar. Rub into salmon filets.

Dump coals evenly around grill and toss in wood chips. Re-apply grate, then quickly swab grill with the towel. Add salmon filets, skin side down, to the hottest part of the grill and cook 2–3 minutes per side for medium rare, rotating 90 degrees halfway through cooking to make grill marks.
Brush meat side with sauce and cook until charred and crispy on the meat side, about 30 seconds. Serve immediately.
